## Highlights since 0.9.0

- **Synara 1.0.6 in the Agent panel.** The bundled agent runtime moves to Synara 1.0.6.
- **Smoother long documents.** Typing no longer re-renders the PDF preview on every keystroke.
- **A clearer TODOs panel.** TODOs are grouped by file, with a new illustration when there is nothing left to do.
- **A tidier submission checklist.** The figure inventory and limits have more room.
- **A more focused Lattice.** The Review, Find support, Terms and Responses tools have been removed. Data they saved in your projects stays on disk untouched.
